about.description: Hermes WebUI: The best way to use Hermes Agent from the web or from your phone!

name: v0.52.701
body:
## Known issues
- **Context meter after a reload or model switch (#8975).** For some sessions on custom or self-hosted endpoints, the
  context meter can show the default window (256K) instead of the model's real window after a page reload or a model
  switch. It corrects itself on the next turn. Compression and chats are unaffected. Context-management plugins that
  read WebUI's context window see the same default until then.
- Credentials can pair with the wrong URL on Agent builds after hermes-agent #151775 when a providers: entry named like a built-in provider has its own URL and model.base_url differs (#8973, Form 3). Present in every release; not fixed yet.
- **"Always allow" on approvals WebUI holds (#9128).** With an Agent connected, "Always allow" on an approval that WebUI holds lasts for the session but isn't saved, so a new session asks again. It never allows more than you chose. It isn't fixed yet; #9128 tracks it.
- **Agent builds with the new persistence backend (#9149, #9157).** Hermes Agent `main` since Nov 17 and canary builds since Nov 18 (no Agent release yet) break parts of WebUI: a reused conversation can fail on its next message, and session titles, workspace folders and token counts stop syncing to the Agent's database. The Agent v0.23.2 release and earlier are unaffected; `main` and canary installs report a version like 0.23.2+N, and the ones built since those dates are affected. Fixes are in exp-v0.52.713, exp-v0.52.715 and exp-v0.52.718, with more in progress; they come to stable with a later promotion.


## What's Changed
* Release exp-v0.52.680: async-delegation completions are claimed and acknowledged against their own profile's ledger (#8977) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8997
* fix: bind async delegation delivery to its owning profile ledger (#7214) by @yehsi2000 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8977
* Release exp-v0.52.681: `/api/btw` sends its duplicate-stream error outside the stream registry lock (#9051) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9057
* fix(btw): write duplicate-stream 409 outside STREAMS_LOCK (#9031) by @webtecnica in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9051
* Release exp-v0.52.682: removing a provider's API key no longer leaves an empty provider entry (#9026) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9059
* fix(providers): drop an emptied provider entry when its API key is removed (#6335) by @webtecnica in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9026
* Release exp-v0.52.683: in Gateway chat mode, the handoff summary no longer builds an in-process agent (#9016) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9062
* Return the local handoff summary instead of an in-process agent in gateway mode by @samikrc in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9016
* Release exp-v0.52.684: `/api/tts` picks the Edge voice by the text's language when the request names no voice (#8911) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9064
* fix(tts): pick the Edge voice by text language; widen the allowlist by @fedebyes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8911
* Release exp-v0.52.685: Agent-dependent tests run again (#9033, #9042) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9066
* test: run agent-module tests when the Agent venv predates a module (conftest import gate) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9033
* fix(tests): unskip test_approval_unblock.py by importing _ApprovalEntry from tools.approval_gateway_wait by @webtecnica in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9042
* Release exp-v0.52.686: external memory providers keep working with Hermes Agent v0.23.2 and later (#9063) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9068
* fix(memory): pass the Agent's claim arguments through the shared-instance guard (#9060) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9063
* Release exp-v0.52.687: the cron delivery picker offers every messaging platform again on current Agents (#9067) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9070
* fix(cron): offer plugin-registry delivery platforms in the cron picker (#9058) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9067
* Release exp-v0.52.688: the model picker's Configured rows show the model's role instead of the raw routing key (#8739) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9073
* fix(model picker): show the role in the Configured chip instead of the raw routing key (#8733) by @webtecnica in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8739
* Release exp-v0.52.689: a cross-profile session load resets the Tasks panel like the profile picker does (#9076) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9082
* fix(sessions): reset profile-scoped Tasks state on cross-profile session load (#9069) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9076
* Release exp-v0.52.690: the test suite runs against a temporary Hermes home (#9079) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9086
* test: sandbox the real Hermes home for the whole suite, with a best-effort write guard by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9079
* Release exp-v0.52.691: a profile switch clears the previous profile's Tasks rows and skill cache at once (#9083) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9090
* fix(tasks): drop the previous profile's Tasks rows and skill cache on profile switch (#9080) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9083
* Release exp-v0.52.692: /goal reads inline contract lines and refuses /goal gate with clear guidance (#8979) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9092
* fix: parse /goal contract lines and refuse /goal gate by @SajjadPSavoji in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8979
* docs(changelog): stamp v0.52.678 by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9094
* Release exp-v0.52.693: turns on a non-default profile keep plugin-discovered secrets on newer Agents (#9085) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9091
* fix(profiles): stamp the per-turn secret scope with the profile home (#9084) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9085
* Release exp-v0.52.694: a stale-writeback stream ends with a terminal event, and published successes stay successful (#8624) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9097
* fix(stream): emit a terminal error when a stale writeback is skipped by @solarmaster961 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8624
* Release exp-v0.52.695: imported CLI sessions keep their profile, and the sidebar's state.db data stays within the active profile (#9100, #9093) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9103
* fix(profiles): imported CLI sessions keep their profile; sidebar state.db metadata stays within the active profile (#9093) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9100
* docs(changelog): stamp v0.52.679 by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9107
* Release exp-v0.52.696: typing a skill's exact name in the slash menu puts that skill first (#9049, #9035) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9109
* fix(slash): rank exact skill-name matches first in autocomplete (#9035) by @webtecnica in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9049
* Release exp-v0.52.697: P1: clicking the YOLO pill can no longer turn auto-approval on or approve a waiting command (#9116, part of #9101) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9117
* fix(yolo): keep the YOLO pill on the open session and make its click only disable (#9101) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9116
* Release exp-v0.52.698: Hermes Agent v0.23.2 support: approvals reach the Agent again, and chats in different sessions run concurrently (#9121, #9122) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9127
* fix(approvals): bind each Agent approval name separately and fail loudly (#9119) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9121
* fix(skills): keep chats concurrent on Agents where skill_manager_tool shares skills_tool's resolver by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9122
* Release exp-v0.52.699: rendered markdown keeps internal placeholder text out of attribute values (#9123) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9130
* fix(renderer): keep stash tokens out of rendered attribute values by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9123
* Release exp-v0.52.700: text around a tag the renderer removes stays text (#9131) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9132
* fix(renderer): text around a removed tag stays text by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9131
* Release exp-v0.52.701: bare URLs no longer turn into links inside an HTML tag (#9126) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9133
* fix(renderer): autolinking must not rewrite text inside a tag by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9126
